version.description: LogicSpec DSL version. Must be the string "1".

extensions.description: Namespaced extension metadata. Ignored by core validation.

actors.description: Actors, each a declaration or a $ref to a shared actor definition.

kind.description: What kind of participant this actor is. `agent` marks an autonomous AI agent actor.

$ref.description: Reference to a shared step template: "definitions#/steps/<name>". Extra keys override the template (local wins).

label.description: Display label. Defaults to the step id.

boundary.description: Boundary event handlers: documented alternative paths when this step times out, errors, or receives a message/condition mid-flight. Allowed only on subflow, page and parallel steps (LS308).

eventKind.description: Boundary trigger classification (timer/message/signal/error/conditional). Reuses the event eventKind.

interrupting.description: When true (default), firing diverts the flow to `next`; when false, it spawns a parallel descriptive path. Both are descriptive — never fired.

after.description: Timer relative delay (e.g. 30d). Descriptive, never scheduled.

at.description: Timer absolute date/time. Descriptive, never evaluated.

every.description: Timer recurring cadence (e.g. 1d). Descriptive, never scheduled.

event.description: Event name for a message/signal boundary, resolved against the event catalog.

label.description: Optional display label for the boundary edge.

next.description: Target step id the boundary diverts to.

decisionTable.description: A DMN-style decision table. Mutually exclusive with cases.

inputs.description: Input column headers — the things being tested, e.g. ["age", "country"].

outputs.description: Output column headers (at least one). A reserved "next" column names the target step; the rest are descriptive results, e.g. ["tier", "next"].

hitPolicy.description: How matching rules combine. Declarative label, never evaluated. Defaults to "unique".

when.description: One predicate cell per input column, in order. "-" or "" means any. Never evaluated.

then.description: One value cell per output column, in order. Never evaluated.

rules.description: Rule rows. Each row has one when-cell per input and one then-cell per output.

zones.description: Agent zones: named regions bounding autonomous, order-not-fixed AI-agent behavior. Descriptive annotation only — never executed or reordered.

label.description: Display label for the agent zone, e.g. "AI Triage".

description.description: Optional prose describing what the agent does in this region.

kind.description: Zone kind. Defaults to "agent" — the only kind for now.

steps.description: Step ids inside this agent's autonomous region. Each must resolve to a real step, and a step belongs to at most one zone (LS309).
